notes.title: Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror launches March 28 on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11521469/11457eb25137af06de2ed55da314c8e9476677a6.jpg[/img]
Hello, Horror fans!

We’re thrilled to announce that [i][b]Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror[/b][/i], the newest installment in the Dollhouse series, will officially launch on[b] Steam[/b] on [b]March 28, 2025[/b]! Prepare to join Eliza on a haunting journey through two nightmarish realities and uncover the twisted mystery of her broken mind. 

To celebrate, we’ve just unveiled a brand-new trailer, offering a glimpse into the immersive gameplay, unsettling challenges, and bone-chilling encounters that await in this psychological horror experience.

[previewyoutube=oIaeFDudFfA;full][/previewyoutube]

Be sure to add Dollhouse: Behind The Broken Mirror to your wishlist today to stay updated on all the latest news and prepare yourself for the darkness ahead.

[h2]Wishlist NOW[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791660/Dollhouse_Behind_the_Broken_Mirror/

notes.title: Wacky VR sim Traffic Jams is out now [10% OFF]
notes.content:
[b]In this wacky VR game, control traffic your way in the face of outrageous events and flagrant road rage. Easy? Think again! Traffic Jams throws in monsters, (un)natural disasters, and up to 4 non-VR friends in party mode![/b]

[url=https://youtu.be/trETkh4nBnI][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33738013/a0924461e784c0bb89011cdc53a32ffc64edab1a.jpg[/img][/url]

Starting out on a quiet corner in a small town, job offers start pouring in from around the globe. Guide rude pedestrians, impatient drivers, and the occasional meteorite along before road rage strikes. Sound easy? Think again! This wacky VR game is full of monsters, (un)natural disasters, and something called… ‘cheese bowling’?

Made it to the top in career mode? Keep your VR headset cool as up to 4 non-VR friends turn up the heat in (couch) party mode!

[b]Save 10% on Traffic Jams until 14 April 2021[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301930/Traffic_Jams?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=announcement&utm_campaign=launch][h1][BUY NOW][/h1][/url]

Traffic Jams is developed by Little Chicken Game Company (REKT!, Track Labs) and published by Vertigo Games.

notes.content:
Hi everyone,

That's all for now, have a great day!

-Marten

notes.title: 1 Week of Adam
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

SOEDESCO launched Adam’s Venture: Origins last week. When we embarked on this Venture (pun intended) we wanted to publish a cool adventure game, for a very broad audience. The traditional adventure game has disappeared. Variety is the spice of life, and it is our hope that Adam’s Venture: Origins provides that variety. With a focus on puzzles, goofy banter and a story clearly inspired by old adventure books and comics.
 
But let’s trim the fat and skip past the lofty ambitions. At the moment there are a few things we are working on. We’ve received bug reports and other reports about technical issues. The devs are hard at work fixing your issues and once we have a good idea of what’s causing some of these issues and a general ETA on the fixes then we’ll let you know. If you have a bug to report, please include your crash report, which can be found in: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Adam's Venture Orgins\AV_Origins_Data\output_log.txt. Make sure to include you system specs as well, they are very helpful when we try to isolate(and solve) the problem. 

More importantly we would like to thank all our players for playing the game, and special thank you for all the submitted gameplay footage and streams are also very much appreciated. We tried to make Adam’s Venture: Origins for a very broad audience by including lots of different languages. The amount of content we’ve seen around the internet proves that was the right call to make! So great work on your puzzle solving and grappling hook skills.

Because that’s the general point we want to make here. Thanks everyone for participating, playing and enjoying our latest game. We’ve heard your feedback about all kinds of stuff and we’ll take it to heart. We’ll keep you updated on the technical side of things, so let’s keep in touch. 

Have a nice weekend!

Stoom, on behalf of the SOEDESCO team.

notes.title: Adam's Venture: Origins, what's changed?
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, 

So we've seen some questions pop up about the content of the game, and to what extent this 'remaster' changes things. So for that reason we thought it prudent to list all of that in one place for convenient future reference ; - )

So without further ado, let's dive into why we think that Adam's Venture: Origins is more than your average 'remaster'. 

A small journey into the murky mist of time is required since that is where our story begins. Adam's Venture was first released into the world in the form of episodic adventure games, the first of which was released in 2009, which is by now 7 years ago. 

Last year we (SOEDESCO) bundled the episodes into Adam's Venture: Chronicles. We also gave it to everyone who owned all the three episodes on Steam. 

At that time we had already announced Adam's Venture: Origins, our new start for the franchise. We promised the fulfilment of a vision. That means a puzzle focused adventure game with a focus on brains and wit over violence and guns. We wanted to release a game that was also up to snuff on the technical side of things. 

We are working with the original developer Vertigo Games, to make sure that the original tone and artistic vision was respected. In addition to that, Vertigo knows Adam and his story best, and had a good idea of which challenges we would encounter in producing a new Adam's Venture game. 

All fine and dandy, but why don't you get down to the nitty gritty details? Let's do that, backing it up with some facts. 

[list]
[*] Was rebuilt in a totally new engine (Unity 5)
[*] Has a replotted and in places rewritten storyline. From 3 separate episodes to 1 coherent game. 
[*] Features a new grappling hook mechanic, used in new puzzles and platform challenges
[*] Has all new graphics, that means new character models, textures, animations, the whole shebang.
[/list]

In addition to that some smaller changes had to be made due to the new platforms we had at our disposal. For instance some cut-scenes were also replaced with dynamic, player-triggered conversations, which meant we had to write and record new voice-acting.

Just to give you some visual reference here are some images we posted on our Facebook pages: 


[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/280721044807220443/857F156A2918B5AB40B677F8B9719DDB1A498067/[/img]

[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/280721044807230860/7A26D682703F42161FCAB6DDF6EA92CCCB1F9F73/[/img]

We hope this illustrates the points made above. For us Adam's Venture: Origins is a fresh start for the franchise. A new beginning, and we hope that people can now finally experience Adam's Venture in a way that is as close as possible to the original vision Vertigo had. 

If you have any questions or are curious at the process behind making Adam's Venture: Origins please respond to this thread. 

Thanks a lot, and we hope you enjoy your adventures with Adam.


Warm regards,
Stoom, on behalf of the SOEDESCO team

notes.title: PUZZLE-ADVENTURE TITLE ADAM’S VENTURE: ORIGINS REVEALS RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
SOEDESCO confirms the comprehensive remake of the cult classic is set to make its debut on April 1st, 2016.

March 09th, 2016 – Rotterdam SOEDESCO and Vertigo Games have confirmed Adam’s Venture: Origins is set to release on PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC on April 1, 2016.

The adventure begins in 1928, when a routine excavation of a French church leads to the discovery of a strange scroll bearing Templar symbols. What follows is a race to uncover the location of the four rivers mentioned in the Book of Genesis – and unpick what this could mean.

Adam’s Venture: Origins was first announced last year and is a remake of the original Adam’s Venture Chronicles – The Search for the Lost Garden, Soloman’s Secret and Revelations. Set in the 1920’s, Adam’s Venture Origins is an extensive remake of the originally announced game, reimagining the franchise as a fully formed non-violent, next-generation adventure game.

Streamlined with the power of Unity 5 and replotted to forge an engaging narrative, this is the definitive Adam’s Venture experience. Over the course of their adventures, players will find themselves crossing the globe, visiting locations like Jerusalem, Oxford, and even Temple Mount.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uaIeman1_ZQ

See the first gameplay trailer and screenshots for the game below, showing off our hero careering through a bat-infested cave in a runaway mine cart, navigating perilous ruins in a wide-range of countries, and taking on a selection of the title’s fiendishly challenging puzzles.

notes.title: ADAM SWINGS INTO ACTION ONCE MORE WITH NEW TRAILER
notes.content:
[h1]ADAM’S VENTURE: ORIGINS GETS FIRST GAMEPLAY TRAILER[/h1]


[b]ROTTERDAM, THE NETHERLANDS[/b](17-02-2016) – SOEDESCO has released the first full trailer for upcoming puzzle-adventure title Adam’s Venture: Origins. The trailer offers would-be adventurers their first look at the tasks awaiting them when the game hits PlayStation 4, Xbox One and PC in early 2016.

Check out the trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uaIeman1_ZQ&feature=youtu.be

The adventure begins in 1928, when a routine excavation of a French church leads to the discovery of a strange scroll bearing Templar symbols. What follows is a race to uncover the location of the four rivers mentioned in the Book of Genesis – and unpick what this could mean.

The trailer below reveals some of the challenges Adam will have to overcome, from careering through a bat-infested cave in a runaway mine cart, to navigating perilous ruins in a wide-range of countries. A selection of the game’s fiendishly challenging puzzles are also showcased – check them out here along with some new screenshots:
 
[b]WHAT IS ADAM’S VENTURE: ORIGINS?[/b]

Adam’s Venture: Origins was first announced last year. Set in the 1920’s, Adam’s Venture Origins is an extensive remake of the originally announced game, reimagining the franchise as a fully formed non-violent, next generation adventure game. The game is streamlined and replotted to forge an engaging narrative that plays out across a single game experience.

Using Unity 5, Adam’s Venture: Origins features enhanced, next-gen visuals, new gameplay, and new animation work to make this into a much improved and engaging experience. Combined with challenging puzzles, stunning visuals, engaging narrative and tight gameplay, Adam’s Venture: Origins is set to mark the fulfillment of the original vision of developer Vertigo Games.

A release date for the game is set to be revealed shortly.
